name: Jarl Needs Eyes
label: Quest
description: "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor wants 40 unpopped Darkmist eyes, because Darkmist eye juice is smooth and salty. The spiders live in Darkmist…
intro: "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor wants 40 unpopped Darkmist eyes, because Darkmist eye juice is smooth and salty. The spiders live in Darkmist Cavern, west of the manor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Eye juice is good juice for drinking. Too bad most critters only have two eyes.
But spiders have lots of eyes. Lots and lots. And Darkmist eye juice is tasty. Smooth and salty! Unpopped spider eyes... I taste them already.
Darkmist spiders are west of here, in the Darkmist Cavern. You figure the spiders are named after the cave... Or is it the other way around?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got the eyes! You got the eyes! Tasty, tasty spider eyes!
Some eyes... When you stare at them they stare back. Eat those last. They keep you company... Out in the swamp.
Hello, little spider eyes. Hello! You taste like chicken. Gooey, salty chicken!
